title: Vegan Stir Fry Pleaser
description: A quick and easy vegan stir fry recipe that's perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish is packed with protein-rich fermented foods and a variety of colorful vegetables.
instructions: Heat the stir-fry oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the vegan egg substitute and cook until it's lightly browned and crispy.
Add the bell peppers and broccoli to the skillet and cook until they're tender-crisp.
Add the fermented soybeans and light soy sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the stir fry hot over rice or noodles.
